data.title: Rheb binds and regulates the mTOR kinase
data.authors: Long X; Avruch J et al.

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: Rheb binds the mTOR kinase domain and directly stimulates its activity.
data.abstract_excerpt: The target of rapamycin (TOR), in complex with the proteins raptor and LST8 (TOR complex 1), phosphorylates the p70S6K and 4E-BP1 to promote mRNA translation. Genetic evidence establishes that TOR complex activity in vivo requires the small GTPase Rheb, and overexpression of Rheb can rescue TOR from inactivation in vivo by amino-acid withdrawal. The Tuberous Sclerosis heterodimer (TSC1/TSC2) functions as a Rheb GTPase activator and inhibits TOR signaling in vivo.

extracted_findings.effect: Rheb binds and directly regulates the mTOR kinase (with TSC1/2 acting as its GAP)
